request.style: English, solemn female soprano solo with harmonizing choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, strings, warm and uplifting mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Hold each other in the highest love
Because of the work they do
Live in peace with one another
Admonish the idle and few

[Verse]
Comfort the discouraged hearts
Help the weak along the way
Be patient with everyone
Never repay evil

[Chorus]
Rejoice always in your day
Pray without ceasing now
Give thanks in all circumstances
This is God's will for you

[Verse]
In Christ Jesus this is true
Do not quench the Spirit's fire
Do not treat prophecies with contempt
Test everything carefully

[Chorus]
Rejoice always in your day
Pray without ceasing now
Give thanks in all circumstances
This is God's will for you

[Bridge]
Hold on to what is good
Test all things with care
Let the Spirit guide your soul
In every moment there

[Outro]
Give thanks in all circumstances
This is God's will for you
